mapper.select: SELECT c.community_id AS communityId, c.community_code AS communityCode, c.community_name AS communityName, c.address_line AS address, c.longitude, c.latitude, c.coordinate_system AS coordinateSystem, COUNT(DISTINCT b.building_id) AS buildingCount, COUNT(DISTINCT p.property_unit_id) AS propertyCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.occupancy_status IN ('OWNER_OCCUPIED', 'TENANT_OCCUPIED') THEN p.property_unit_id END) AS occupiedPropertyCount FROM community c LEFT JOIN building b ON b.community_id = c.community_id AND b.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_id = b.building_id AND bu.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN property_unit p ON p.building_unit_id = bu.building_unit_id AND p.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.community_id IN #{scopeId}AND 1 = 0 GROUP BY c.community_id, c.community_code, c.community_name, c.address_line, c.longitude, c.latitude, c.coordinate_system ORDER BY c.community_id

SELECT b.building_id AS buildingId, c.community_id AS communityId, c.community_name AS communityName, b.building_no AS buildingNo, b.building_name AS buildingName, CONCAT(c.address_line, COALESCE(NULLIF(b.building_name, ''), b.building_no)) AS fullAddress, b.longitude, b.latitude, b.total_floors AS totalFloors, b.location_source AS locationSource, COUNT(DISTINCT bu.building_unit_id) AS unitCount, COUNT(DISTINCT p.property_unit_id) AS propertyCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.occupancy_status IN ('OWNER_OCCUPIED', 'TENANT_OCCUPIED') THEN p.property_unit_id END) AS occupiedPropertyCount FROM building b INNER JOIN community c ON c.community_id = b.community_id AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_id = b.building_id AND bu.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN property_unit p ON p.building_unit_id = bu.building_unit_id AND p.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE b.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.community_id IN #{scopeId}AND 1 = 0 GROUP BY b.building_id, c.community_id, c.community_name, c.address_line, b.building_no, b.building_name, b.longitude, b.latitude, b.total_floors, b.location_source ORDER BY c.community_id, b.building_id
